intelligence.simple_view: Imagine your page is a little house on your phone! You get to pick the picture on the door — your face, or a shiny ball with your letter on it! You choose if your house is open to everyone or just your friends. You choose what to tell the magic friend, so it can find friends just like you. Your three favourite things sit on a shelf by the door. And every time you earn stars, your special name changes — five stars, you're a five star member! And when you open a little window, it opens BIG, so you can read it easily. And your friends help build it fast — but they get it RIGHT the first time, so nobody has to build it twice!

The picture on the door, whether it's open or private, what you tell the system about yourself, your top three favourite places, the stars you earn — all yours, dear. And when a little window pops up, it opens right up big, so you can read it properly, love, with a nice little X to close it. The work gets done fast today, dear — one thing after another, lots of helpers — but everyone understands the job first, so it's right the first time and nobody has to do it twice. Fast and right, love — that's the way.

Tell the demographics what you choose, and they find people like you. Feature your top three. Your level is your name; the bar runs to ten stars. Pop-ups open big, almost full screen. The composer makes the most beautiful post in the network. And I work fast — one round after another — with understanding before building, so it lands right first time. Speed never buys a redo.
